seo.title: Cervinia ski resort guide
seo.description: A lift network linking Breuil-Cervinia, Valtournenche, Chamois and Torgnon with Zermatt, and a snowpark running since 2003.
seo.twitterDescription: Skiing from Italy into Zermatt, under the Matterhorn.
seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts, where to stay and how to get to Cervinia in the Aosta Valley.

h1: Cervinia ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Breuil-Cervinia sits at just over 2,000 metres on the Italian side of the Matterhorn, and its lift network reaches across the border: the operator counts Breuil-Cervinia, Valtournenche, Chamois, Torgnon and Zermatt as one ski area. Snowpark Cervinia has run at the foot of the mountain since 2003, and the Plateau Rosa glacier lifts keep turning outside the winter season.
stayOverview: Breuil-Cervinia is a purpose-built resort at the head of the valley, right at the lifts. Valtournenche further down is cheaper and on the same lift network.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. Breuil-Cervinia puts you at the lifts; Valtournenche is the value end of the same mountain.
rentalCars: Breuil-Cervinia is at the end of the Valtournenche road, about an hour from Aosta and 45 kilometres from the motorway.
